description: This file defines the RecursiveContextualValidator class, which implements a recursive validation mechanism for Typed Data in Drupal, utilizing Symfony Validator components. It handles validation of complex and list data structures, including constraint validation and violation collection.

classes.name: RecursiveContextualValidator
classes.description: Implements a recursive validator for Typed Data, handling complex and list data structures, and managing constraint validation and violation collection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validator with execution context, metadata factory, constraint validator factory, and typed data manager.

methods.name: atPath
methods.description: Stub method for setting validation path; currently not used.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates data against constraints, converting data to TypedDataInterface if necessary, and initiates recursive validation.

methods.name: validateNode
methods.description: Recursively validates a TypedData node, its properties, or list items, against constraints.

methods.name: validateConstraints
methods.description: Validates a value against a set of constraints, avoiding duplicate validations.

methods.name: getViolations
methods.description: Returns the list of validation violations collected.

methods.name: validateProperty
methods.description: Validates a specific property of a TypedData object.

methods.name: validatePropertyValue
methods.description: Validates a specific property value of a TypedData object.
